title: A session without a lead brief is proven at run time to stay in its checkout
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-19, standards enforcement audit after #1521 (docs/program/standards-enforcement.md). Evidence: repository-workflow.md:27: test/rules/session-role.test.ts checks only the workflow text; nothing proves at run time that a session without a lead brief stays in its checkout.
Files: test/rules/session-role.test.ts, src/hook/scope.ts
Outcome: A runtime test drives the session-start and scope hooks with a captured non-lead session payload and proves it is refused writes outside its checkout and lead-only commands (krn task ready/claim/release).
Proof: node --test on the touched test with a captured hook payload (KRN-12): pass.
